purpose: Add a second fact beyond the first: not only A but also B.
keywords: Plain form + ばかりでなく; noun / な-adjective + である + ばかりでなく
She not only sings but also writes music.
This road is not only narrow but also dark at night.
He is not only a doctor but also a writer.
formation: Plain form + ばかりでなく; noun / な-adjective + である + ばかりでなく
restrictions: The two facts should build the same argument; も often marks the added item.
mistake: Do not use this to contrast two opposing facts.
